name: 2020 08 05 August PC Agenda Page (Revised)
agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  ECONOMIC AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MEETING AGENDA
August 5, 2020 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor (Planning Commission & Staff)
1 West Manchester Boulevard

  COVID-19 PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS

Due to the existing COVID-19 health emergency and the social
distancing measures currently in effect, and pursuant to the
Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20 ((https://www.gov.ca.gov/wp-
content/uploads/2020/03/3.17.20-N-29-20-EO.pdf)),  please  note
that members of the public will only be allowed to observe and
address the Planning Commission Meeting of August 5 July 1, 2020
at 7:00 P.M. by telephone, video and other electronic means, as
follows:

Viewing and Listening to the Meeting without Making Public
Comments:
  x On Spectrum Cable Local Channel 35 with audio and limited
  video. Please check with your cable provider for details.
  x Live on-line through Facebook Live, with audio and limited
  video, at https://www.facebook.com/cityofinglewood/
  x The above access options provide the public with the
  opportunity to both observe and listen to the meeting.
  x However, members of the public who wish to orally address
  the Planning Commission must use the public access options
  noted below:

Listening to the Meeting and Making Oral Public Comments:
Members of the public may listen and make oral public comments
telephonically by dialing:

  Dial-in: 1-888-251-2949 or 215-861-0694
  Access Code: 4324563## 5588592##

Please observe the following tips when phoning in:

  x  When you call-in, the operator will provide further
  instructions on how you can make public comments via phone.
  x  If you are calling from a cell phone, please call from an
  area with good reception.
  x  If you are watching the meeting on Facebook or Channel 35
  while also accessing the phone line, it is requested that
  you mute the sound of your video feed as it is offset by 3
  seconds from the phone transmission. Additionally, when you
  are making public comments on the phone line you will be
  inaudible due to feedback.

Written Public Comments: Members of the public can submit
comments for consideration by the Planning Commission by sending
them  to  Mindy  Wilcox,  AICP,  Planning  Manager  at
mwilcox@cityofinglewood.org. To ensure distribution to the
members of the Planning Commission prior to consideration of the
agenda, comments must be received prior to 12:00 P.M. on August
5, 2020, the day of the meeting. Correspondence should indicate
the meeting date and agenda item. Comments received after 12:00
P.M. and prior to close of the public hearing will be made part
of the official public record of the meeting.

[Agenda Items and Additional Public Access Options Listed on
Following Pages]
 1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to
  address the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda
  other than a public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  PUBLIC HEARINGS
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by Shomof
  Hospitality, LLC, for Special Use Permit No. 2020-004
  (SP-2020-004) to allow 1) the on-site consumption of beer
  and wine and distilled spirits, 2) outdoor dining, and 3)
  outdoor  live  entertainment  within  a  hotel,  hotel
  restaurant, and hotel pool lounge on an approximately
  86,102 square-foot, M-1L (Limited Manufacturing) zoned
  property at 3900 West Century.
  Preliminary Recommendations:
  1. Affirm Notice of Exemption EA-CE-2020-032;
  2. Adopt the attached resolution approving SP-2020-004
  subject to 22 conditions to allow:
  a. Outdoor dining, and
  b. Sale of beer and wine for on-site consumption.

  b. A public hearing to consider an application by Patrik
  Purnag, Owner, for Special Use Permit No. 2020-005 (SP-
  2020-005) to subdivide a property into four (4)
  condominium units on an approximately 7,500 square-foot
  R-3 (Multiple-family Residential) zoned property at 334
  East Stepney Street.
  Preliminary Recommendations:
  1. Affirm Notice of Exemption EA-CE-2020-014; and
  2. Adopt the attached resolution approving SP-2020-005
  subject to 16 conditions.

  c. A public hearing to consider an application by Jeff
  Williams, representing 7-Eleven, for Special Use Permit
  No. 2020-007 (SP-2020-007) to allow the sale of beer and
  wine for off-site consumption from a proposed convenience
  market on an approximately 9,083 square-foot, C-2 (General
  Commercial) zoned property at 837 South Prairie Avenue.
  Preliminary Recommendations:
  1. Affirm Notice of Exemption EA-CE-2020-044; and
  2. Make a determination on whether Public Convenience or
  Necessity is served by this request, and
  3. Adopt the attached resolution approving SP-2020-007
  subject to 30 conditions.

6.  NON-PUBLIC HEARINGS

  a. A non-public hearing to consider an application by Brian
  Massie, representing Hillcrest Ventures, LLC for Design
  Review No. 2020-003 (DR-2020-003) to allow exterior
  improvements to an existing 6-story medical office
  building that will be converted into a mixed-use
  development that includes 65 residential units on an
  approximately  23,833  square-foot  property  at  336
  Hillcrest Boulevard.
  Preliminary Recommendations:
  1. Preliminary CEQA Recommendation:

  2
   a. Affirm Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2020-041;
  and
  b. Adopt findings and the attached resolution
  approving  DR-2020-003  subject  to  9
  conditions.

  b)  A non-public hearing to consider an application by Linc-Core
  Fairview Metro, L.P. for Planning Commission Review No. 2020-
  001 (PCR-2020-001) to approve the Public Art Plan for
  installation of onsite artwork related to construction of a
  new 2-story mixed-use building of 101 residential units,
  commercial/retail spaces and associated parking spaces on a M-
  U-3(Mixed-Use 3) zoned property at 923 East Redondo Boulevard.
  1. Preliminary Recommendations:
  a. Preliminary Recommendations: Adopt Findings and
  the attached resolution approving PCR-2020-001
  subject to conditions.

  c)  Cosmetology School Overview

7.  Commission Initiatives.

8.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning
  Commission on any matter within their jurisdiction and not
  elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

10.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations, due to a disability,
please contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One
Manchester Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall,
Inglewood, CA 90301. All requests for special accommodations
must be received 48 hours prior to the day of the hearing(s).
"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información,
favor de llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."
In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of August 5,
2020 is not held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or
other agenda item being considered, the public hearing or non-
public hearing agenda item will automatically be continued to
the next regular Planning Commission meeting.

Hearing materials are available at
https://www.cityofinglewood.org/AgendaCenter/Planning-
Commission-4 and at City Hall, 1st Floor Lobby Information Desk
during regular business hours. If any additional documents are
distributed to the Planning Commission after publication of this
Agenda, they will be made available for public inspection at the
following webpage
(https://www.cityofinglewood.org/AgendaCenter/Planning-
Commission-4)

(Note: The above procedures are subject to change for future
Commission meetings. Please refer to future Planning Commission
agendas for public participation option procedures at that
time.)

  NEXT REGULAR PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 2, 2020, 7:00 P.M.
  INGLEWOOD CITY HALL, COUNCIL CHAMBERS, NINTH FLOOR
  ONE WEST MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301

 Refer to September 2nd Agenda for public participation options
  at that meeting.
